Malzahar.escape: Malzahar has no ability to create distance, so dodge Malzahar Q Call of the Void, break Malzahar P Void Shift, then close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark. Don’t go in alone while Malzahar R Nether Grasp is a threat; fight where an ally can interrupt its cast with immobilizing crowd control. After engaging, use the shadow left by Zed R Death Mark as your escape route.
Malzahar.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Malzahar’s main damage is magic, and Zed has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance and build Maw of Malmortius. Malzahar R Nether Grasp deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that greatly increase health alone.
Malzahar.combo: First break Malzahar P Void Shift with Zed Q Razor Shuriken. Then restore your energy and wait for your abilities to come off cooldown before engaging. Apply the mark with Zed R Death Mark, place Zed W Living Shadow, and hit Malzahar with Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash from both you and your shadow. When Malzahar drops below half health, add one basic attack to trigger Zed P Contempt for the Weak.
Malzahar.fight: After breaking Malzahar P Void Shift, send Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind him and trade with Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash. Find an angle where both your shadow’s and your own shurikens hit Malzahar, and slow him with your shadow’s Zed E Shadow Slash. Don’t force a solo engage while Malzahar Q Call of the Void or Malzahar R Nether Grasp is available.
Malzahar.laning: Step back from minions affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions, since the damage can spread to you when they die. If Malzahar pushes the lane, break Malzahar P Void Shift with Zed Q Razor Shuriken and pressure him with your jungler. You’re vulnerable right after using Zed W Living Shadow to poke, so save it if the enemy jungler is missing.
Malzahar.phase: Zed peaks in the mid game when he has a couple of items, so pressure Malzahar’s growth from the early game and build a lead then. Malzahar gets stronger as the game goes on while Zed falls off late, so you’re at a disadvantage the longer the game lasts.
Malzahar.teamfight: Watch for Malzahar P Void Shift, Malzahar Q Call of the Void, and Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a flank or the backline instead of engaging head-on. If Malzahar W Void Swarm’s voidlings are already out, clear them first with an area-of-effect ability like Zed Q Razor Shuriken, and engage when there are no voidlings. After the enemy has used their protection and crowd control on your team, target one enemy with Zed R Death Mark and survive until the mark detonates so you can escape with your shadow.
Malzahar.watch: When Malzahar P Void Shift is active, he takes reduced damage, so break it first with Zed Q Razor Shuriken before engaging. If you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void being cast, delay your engage and move outside the portal to avoid the silence. Malzahar R Nether Grasp’s suppression can’t be escaped with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark, so don’t enter an area without vision alone while Malzahar can cast R.

Akshan.fight: After that, make Akshan use Akshan E Heroic Swing, then close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark. You're vulnerable right after using Zed W Living Shadow, so don't waste it on poke when the enemy jungler is missing.
Akshan.build: Akshan's main damage is physical, so build armor first. Zed's damage is mostly physical and Akshan has relatively low armor, so Zed's damage also lands effectively.
Akshan.combo: For a basic trade, send Zed W Living Shadow to Akshan's side or behind him, then use Zed Q Razor Shuriken followed by Zed E Shadow Slash. If Akshan E Heroic Swing is down and your energy and ability cooldowns are ready, engage first with Zed R Death Mark, place Zed W Living Shadow, then hit with Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash from both you and your shadow. If Akshan is below half health, weave in a basic attack before the mark detonates to apply Zed P Contempt for the Weak.
Akshan.escape: The moment after you make Akshan use Akshan E Heroic Swing is your chance to engage with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark. If you placed Zed W Living Shadow safely behind you before engaging, return to it right after the mark detonates to escape.
Akshan.laning: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range when it hits minions, so don't stand behind the wave and take poke. Don't use Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions; create an angle with Zed W Living Shadow so both you and your shadow hit with your abilities and manage your energy.
Akshan.phase: In the late game, Zed's power drops sharply when opponents build armor and group up, so avoid engaging head-on.
Akshan.teamfight: Target Akshan as Zed from a flank or behind, and engage with Zed R Death Mark after the enemy uses their protection and crowd control on your team. Secure a place to return to with Zed W Living Shadow so you can survive until the mark detonates. If Akshan W Going Rogue marks you as a scoundrel, enemies you killed revive when he kills you, so don't face him alone.
Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range each time it hits an enemy, so don't stand behind minions and get hit by it; dodge both its outgoing and return paths. Akshan E Heroic Swing lets him engage and disengage using walls, so watch for him to use it near a wall. If Akshan R Comeuppance targets you while your health is low, don't run alone into the open; move behind terrain.

Ahri.laning: Keep a line of minions between you and Ahri to dodge Ahri E Charm, and stay clear of Ahri Q Orb of Deception's return path. Don't spend energy using Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions; land abilities from Zed W Living Shadow’s shadow and your own abilities together to get energy back. When the enemy jungler is missing, don't use Zed W Living Shadow to poke if you need it to escape.
Ahri.teamfight: Don't engage head-on. Wait on a flank or behind the enemy for their crowd control, such as Ahri E Charm, to be used on your team. After Ahri E Charm is down, target her with Zed R Death Mark, and keep a return point with Zed W Living Shadow so you can survive until the mark detonates.
Ahri.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Ahri's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance with Maw of Malmortius, but remember that resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Ahri Q Orb of Deception. If Ahri's healing from Ahri P Essence Theft keeps you from killing her with one full combo, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Ahri.combo: For a basic trade, send Zed W Living Shadow to Ahri's side or behind her, then use Zed Q Razor Shuriken followed by Zed E Shadow Slash. If Ahri E Charm is down and your energy and abilities are ready, engage first with Zed R Death Mark, place Zed W Living Shadow, then hit with Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash from both you and your shadow. If Ahri is below half health, weave in one basic attack to apply Zed P Contempt for the Weak.
Ahri.escape: The moment after you dodge Ahri E Charm is your chance to engage. If you placed Zed W Living Shadow safely behind you before going in, return to it after the mark detonates.
Ahri.fight: Right after dodging Ahri E Charm, use Zed W Living Shadow to create an angle to her side or behind her, then trade with Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash. If Ahri R Spirit Rush is down, use Zed R Death Mark to close the gap.
Ahri.phase: In the late game, Zed loses power when opponents build armor and group up, so create an advantage in the mid game to end the game.
Ahri.watch: If Ahri E Charm hits, you can take her full follow-up combo, so keep minions between you and her. Ahri Q Orb of Deception also hits on its return, so keep moving outside its return path even after dodging the first cast.

Naafiri.phase: Look to gain an advantage during Zed’s strong midgame, when he has a couple of items, but maintain broad vision to prepare for Naafiri’s midgame roams. In the late game, Zed’s power falls off, and Naafiri’s pack is also vulnerable to area damage in a front-to-back team fight, so stay with your team so you aren’t picked off while scattered.
Naafiri.build: Prioritize armor and health against Naafiri’s damage. Magic resistance is ineffective against her. If the healing from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate makes her difficult to kill in one combo, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Naafiri.combo: Before going in with Zed R Death Mark, make sure your energy and abilities are ready, then apply the mark first. Follow with Zed W Living Shadow, and aim for both you and the shadow to hit with Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash. If Naafiri is below half health, weave in one basic attack, then retreat to the shadow you set up after the mark detonates.
Naafiri.escape: Don’t go in just because Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers alone is down. Naafiri E Eviscerate and Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit also provide mobility, so look for an opening especially before Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit comes back up. If the first Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hit applies its bleed, delay your engage and create distance.
Naafiri.fight: Place Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Naafiri, then trade with Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash. If Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is also down, close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow and Zed R Death Mark.
Naafiri.laning: Save energy so you can trade and escape; don’t use Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions. Set up an angle with Zed W Living Shadow so both you and the shadow hit the same target to restore energy. Don’t spend Zed W Living Shadow on poke when the enemy jungler is missing.
Naafiri.teamfight: Group up to limit Naafiri’s angle to dive the backline with Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit. Zed shouldn’t be the first to engage from the front; target one enemy damage dealer from the side or rear. Go in with Zed R Death Mark after the enemy’s protective abilities and crowd control have been used, and set up a return point with Zed W Living Shadow.
Naafiri.watch: If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hits you once and applies its bleed, create distance until the bleed ends to avoid a second hit. Naafiri E Eviscerate revives the pack, so don’t let your guard down and go in right after clearing it. Don’t roam alone while Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is ready.

AurelionSol.combo: Trade by placing Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Aurelion Sol, then using Zed Q Razor Shuriken followed by Zed E Shadow Slash. To go for a kill, wait until your energy and ability cooldowns are ready, engage first with Zed R Death Mark, then place Zed W Living Shadow and hit with Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash from both you and your shadow. If he is below half health, use one basic attack before the mark detonates to apply Zed P Contempt for the Weak.
AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on max health and builds Stardust, so stand behind minions and quickly move out of its aim line. If caught by Aurelion Sol E Singularity, move outside immediately, and when your health is low, don't step into its execute range. Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend stuns; when empowered, it also knocks up and creates an area shockwave, so spread out from your allies before engaging.
AurelionSol.build: In the early game, survive with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Aurelion Sol's main damage is magic and Zed has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first and consider Maw of Malmortius. Since Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on max health, don't rely on stacking health alone.
AurelionSol.escape: Engage after Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down and the crowd control from Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend has been used. Before going deep with Zed R Death Mark, place Zed W Living Shadow safely behind you to secure a return point. Escape to that shadow right after the mark detonates.
AurelionSol.fight: Right after Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark. For a short trade, place Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind him, then use Zed Q Razor Shuriken followed by Zed E Shadow Slash. When the enemy jungler is missing, don't waste Zed W Living Shadow on poke since you also need it to escape.
AurelionSol.laning: Pressure Aurelion Sol aggressively early, when he has little Stardust and low armor. Take Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light behind minions and leave its aim line to avoid extra damage and Stardust. Don't use Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions; manage energy by landing abilities from both your Zed W Living Shadow shadow and your own body together.
AurelionSol.phase: Early on, Zed can pressure Aurelion Sol hard while he has little Stardust. After unlocking Zed R Death Mark, Zed can look for solo kills, then build on his advantage around the point when he has a couple of mid-game items. In the late game, Aurelion Sol's permanent Stardust scaling and Zed's falling power make it harder to kill him with the same engage angle.
AurelionSol.teamfight: Don't engage head-on; target one enemy damage dealer from a flank or behind. After Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend is used on your team, engage with Zed R Death Mark and secure a return point with Zed W Living Shadow so you can survive until the mark detonates. Spread out from your allies so you don't get hit together by empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.

Sylas.laning: Don’t exhaust the energy needed for trades and escape by using Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions. When the enemy jungler is out of sight, don’t waste Zed W Living Shadow on harass.
Sylas.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Sylas’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance with Maw of Malmortius. If the healing from Sylas W Kingslayer makes him difficult to kill in one combo, slot Executioner's Calling between core items.
Sylas.combo: Before going in with Zed R Death Mark, make sure your energy and abilities are ready. Apply the mark first with R, then place Zed W Living Shadow and use Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash so both you and the shadow hit Sylas. If Sylas falls below half health, weave in one basic attack to apply Zed P Contempt for the Weak.
Sylas.escape: Don’t engage just because either Sylas W Kingslayer or Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down. Look especially for the window before E comes back up, and set up a safe return point with Zed W Living Shadow when you go in. Escape to that shadow after the mark detonates.
Sylas.fight: For a standard trade, send Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Sylas, then use Zed Q Razor Shuriken followed by Zed E Shadow Slash. Set up an angle where both your and the shadow’s shurikens hit to deal damage and restore energy. Close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark before Sylas E Abscond / Abduct comes back up.
Sylas.phase: In the late game, Zed loses power when the enemy builds armor and groups up, so build a big lead in the midgame.
Sylas.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front; target one enemy damage dealer from the side or rear. Engage with Zed R Death Mark after the enemy’s protective abilities and crowd control have been used on your team, and set up a return point with Zed W Living Shadow so you can survive until the mark detonates.
Sylas.watch: With Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, the chain that follows the first dash is the dangerous part. If it hits, it knocks you up and lets Sylas land his combo, so use Zed W Living Shadow to dodge the second chain. If Sylas Q Chain Lash clips you, immediately leave the intersection where it explodes after a delay.

Akali.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Akali's main damage is magic and Zed has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance and build toward Maw of Malmortius.
Akali.combo: After your energy and ability cooldowns are ready, apply the mark first with Zed R Death Mark. Then place Zed W Living Shadow and use Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash so both you and your shadow hit. If Akali is below half health, weave in one basic attack empowered by Zed P Contempt for the Weak. Return to your shadow after the mark detonates.
Akali.escape: Don't engage just because either Akali W Twilight Shroud or Akali E Shuriken Flip is down. Wait until Akali R Perfect Execution is unavailable and her other mobility is also down before going in. Don't rush an engage while slowed by Akali Q Five Point Strike, and make sure you have a place to return to with Zed W Living Shadow.
Akali.fight: Trade back when Akali comes out of Akali W Twilight Shroud to engage, and trade after dodging the first projectile of Akali E Shuriken Flip. Send Zed W Living Shadow to Akali's side or behind her to overlap two hits of Zed Q Razor Shuriken, then slow her with your shadow's Zed E Shadow Slash. Before Akali R Perfect Execution is available again, close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow and Zed R Death Mark.
Akali.laning: When the enemy jungler is missing, don't waste Zed W Living Shadow on poke. Don't use Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions; create an angle for your shadow and your body to hit the same target and restore energy.
Akali.phase: In the late game, Zed loses power when opponents build armor and group up, so use your mid-game advantage to set up an end to the game.
Akali.teamfight: Don't engage head-on; target one enemy damage dealer from a flank or behind. After the enemy uses their protection and crowd control on your team, engage with Zed R Death Mark and secure a place to return to with Zed W Living Shadow so you can survive until the mark detonates.
Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first projectile of Akali E Shuriken Flip. If it hits, it marks you, and the second dash follows even if you use Zed W Living Shadow to move. You can't dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution by walking, so save Zed W Living Shadow while Akali is on you and use it to create distance when she engages.

Anivia.build: In the early game, survive with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Anivia's main damage is magic and Zed has low magic resistance, so build Maw of Malmortius. If healing keeps you from killing her with one full combo, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Anivia.combo: After your energy and ability cooldowns are ready, engage with Zed R Death Mark and place Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Anivia. Then use Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash so both you and your shadow hit, dealing damage before the mark detonates. If Anivia falls below half health, use one basic attack to apply Zed P Contempt for the Weak.
Anivia.escape: After dodging the stun from Anivia Q Flash Frost is your chance to engage with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark. Anivia has no mobility, so once you close the gap, chase her with your shadow's Zed E Shadow Slash slow.
Anivia.fight: Trade by sending Zed W Living Shadow to Anivia's side or behind her, then using Zed Q Razor Shuriken followed by Zed E Shadow Slash. Hit with both you and your shadow to restore energy, and keep Anivia in place with your shadow's E slow. After dodging Anivia Q Flash Frost, close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark.
Anivia.laning: Don't run out of energy by using Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions.
Anivia.phase: Zed peaks when you have a couple of mid-game items, so build an advantage then. In the late game, Zed is weakened by enemy armor and grouping, and you also have to play around Anivia's terrain control.
Anivia.teamfight: Fight in the wider parts of lane rather than narrow paths in the jungle or river, where Anivia W Crystallize can easily block your escape. Don't engage head-on; from a flank or behind, target one damage dealer with Zed R Death Mark after Anivia uses her crowd control on your team. Before going in, secure a safe return point with Zed W Living Shadow, then escape to that shadow after the mark detonates.
Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost explodes at its current location if recast, stunning you, so don't just sidestep a little; use Zed W Living Shadow to get out of the explosion radius. If you've been hit by Q or are inside a fully grown Anivia R Glacial Storm, Anivia E Frostbite deals more damage, so leave the storm immediately. Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape route in narrow paths.

Annie.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Annie's main damage is magic and Zed has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance with Maw of Malmortius.
Annie.combo: For a short trade, place Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Annie, then use Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash. To go for a kill, wait until your energy and ability cooldowns are ready, engage first with Zed R Death Mark, then place Zed W Living Shadow and hit with Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash from both you and your shadow. If Annie falls below half health, weave in one basic attack to apply Zed P Contempt for the Weak.
Annie.escape: Engage while Annie P Pyromania's stun is down. If you placed Zed W Living Shadow safely behind you before engaging with Zed R Death Mark, return to it right after the mark detonates. If Annie R Summon: Tibbers is still active, leave the area and keep your distance from Tibbers.
Annie.fight: Look to trade right after Annie P Pyromania's stun is spent. For a basic trade, send Zed W Living Shadow to Annie's side or behind her, then use Zed Q Razor Shuriken followed by Zed E Shadow Slash. Annie has no mobility, so close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark while her stun is down.
Annie.laning: Wait outside Annie's range while Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready, then pressure her after she spends it. Don't run out of energy by using Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions. When poking, place Zed W Living Shadow so both you and your shadow hit the same target.
Annie.phase: In the late game, Zed loses power when opponents build armor and group up, so use your mid-game advantage to set up an end to the game.
Annie.teamfight: If Annie is missing or Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready, don't let two or three allies stand stacked together. Don't engage head-on; wait on a flank or behind the enemy, then target one damage dealer with Zed R Death Mark after Annie uses her crowd control on your team. Secure a return point with Zed W Living Shadow so you can survive until the mark detonates.
Annie.watch: White light swirls around Annie when Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready. Don't enter Annie's ability range while it's ready. After Annie R Summon: Tibbers is cast, don't stay near Tibbers even if you kill Annie.

Aurora.build: In the early game, survive with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Aurora's main damage is magic and Zed has low magic resistance, so build Maw of Malmortius. If healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration keeps you from killing her with one full combo, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Aurora.combo: Before engaging with Zed R Death Mark, make sure your energy and ability cooldowns are ready. Apply the mark first with R, place Zed W Living Shadow, then hit with Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash from both you and your shadow. If Aurora falls below half health, weave in one basic attack to apply Zed P Contempt for the Weak, survive until the mark detonates, then escape to your shadow.
Aurora.escape: Engage when both Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding are down, and Aurora R Between Worlds is unavailable. If only one mobility ability is down, she can still escape with the others, so don't rush another engage. Close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow and Zed R Death Mark, but secure a shadow return point before going in.
Aurora.fight: Use Zed W Living Shadow to create an angle to Aurora's side or behind her, then trade with Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash. Make Aurora use Aurora E The Weirding, check her remaining mobility, then engage again. If affected by Aurora Q Twofold Hex and health has decreased, don't let the fight drag on.
Aurora.laning: Manage energy by using Zed Q Razor Shuriken so both your shadow and your body hit the same target. Don't use Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions and lose energy for trades and escape.
Aurora.phase: Zed peaks around the point when he has a couple of mid-game items, so turn opportunities from Aurora's mobility being down into an advantage. In the late game, Zed's power drops sharply when opponents build armor and group up, so create a mid-game advantage that can end the game.
Aurora.teamfight: Don't engage head-on; target Aurora or one enemy damage dealer from a flank or behind. After the enemy uses their protection and crowd control on your team, engage with Zed R Death Mark and secure a return point with Zed W Living Shadow so you can survive until the mark detonates. If Aurora jumped in but didn't contribute to a kill, that's your window to kill her before she re-engages; if an ally was killed, watch for the cooldown reset on Aurora W Across the Veil.
Aurora.watch: If hit by Aurora Q Twofold Hex, you take damage again when it returns, and that damage increases the more health you've lost. If cursed, leave the line between you and Aurora, and if your health is low, retreat before it returns. After Aurora R Between Worlds is cast, you'll be slowed when leaving it, so decide whether to leave before the zone appears.

Azir.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Azir deals mainly magic damage, and Zed has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance and get Maw of Malmortius.
Azir.combo: For trades, send Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Azir, then use Zed Q Razor Shuriken followed by Zed E Shadow Slash. To go for a solo kill, wait for your energy and cooldowns, place Zed W Living Shadow somewhere safe behind you, then close in with Zed R Death Mark and hit with Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash before the mark detonates. If Azir is below half health, weave in one basic attack to trigger Zed P Contempt for the Weak, then return to your shadow right after the mark detonates.
Azir.escape: Right after you force Azir E Shifting Sands, you have a window to close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark. Once Azir R Emperor's Divide is down, enter while the risk of being knocked back is reduced. Before going in, secure a safe spot to return to with Zed W Living Shadow.
Azir.fight: After Azir Q Conquering Sands moves his soldiers and they stop, circle to the side or behind them and target Azir himself. Keep the trade short: place Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Azir, then hit him with Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash. If the enemy jungler is missing, save Zed W Living Shadow for escape instead of using it to harass.
Azir.laning: Pressure Azir when his Azir W Arise! soldiers disappear or his mana is low. Don't use Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions; manage your energy by finding angles where your shadow and body hit the same target.
Azir.phase: Zed is strongest in mid game when he has a couple of items, so build a big lead then. Azir gets stronger as the game goes on while Zed falls off late, so avoid extended fights.
Azir.teamfight: Secure a spot to return to with Zed W Living Shadow, then target Azir from the flank or behind. Enter with Zed R Death Mark after the enemy's protection and crowd control have been used on your team. Approach from different directions in an open area so several of you don't enter a narrow passage together and get knocked back by Azir R Emperor's Divide.
Azir.watch: Stay out of the line of Azir W Arise! soldiers, and approach after Azir Q Conquering Sands moves them and they stop. Azir E Shifting Sands dashes to a soldier and grants a shield, so if he places one near a wall, watch for his escape route in that direction. In narrow passages, Azir R Emperor's Divide can knock several people back together, so avoid entering there.

Corki.build: Consider armor items first to prepare for the physical damage from Corki E Gatling Gun and Corki R Missile Barrage. Armor won't block the magic damage from Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and Corki W Valkyrie, so consider magic resistance too if that damage is a threat. Health helps you withstand the true damage from Corki P Hextech Munitions.
Corki.combo: If Corki W Valkyrie is down and your energy and cooldowns are ready, apply the mark first with Zed R Death Mark. Next, place Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Corki, and use Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash so both you and your shadow hit him. If Corki drops below half health, weave in one basic attack to trigger Zed P Contempt for the Weak, then escape with your shadow after the mark detonates.
Corki.escape: Right after Corki W Valkyrie is down is your chance to enter. If you placed Zed W Living Shadow safely behind you before going in, return to it right after Zed R Death Mark detonates.
Corki.fight: Right after you force Corki W Valkyrie, close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark. For a short trade, place Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Corki, then overlap hits from Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash. Don't fight for long head-on while Corki E Gatling Gun is active; move to the side.
Corki.laning: Pressure Corki during his first five levels, when he's weak, and disrupt his farming. If the enemy jungler is missing, don't use Zed W Living Shadow to harass and leave yourself without an escape. If Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb reveals your position while you're fleeing, don't hold back Zed W Living Shadow; use it to create distance.
Corki.phase: During his first five levels, Corki's base stats are low, so Zed should disrupt his growth by pressuring the lane. Late game, Zed falls off while Corki gets stronger as he builds items, so don't give Corki comfortable time to farm.
Corki.teamfight: Target Corki from the flank or behind instead of going in head-on. Enter with Zed R Death Mark after the enemy's protection and crowd control have been fully expended on your team and Corki W Valkyrie is down. Secure a return point with Zed W Living Shadow so you can survive until the mark detonates.
Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage also damages targets around the first one it hits, so don't hide behind minions; move out of range. Reposition to avoid being hit repeatedly, especially by the third missile. Corki E Gatling Gun reduces your armor and magic resistance, so don't stand your ground in front of him; move to the side.

Ekko.build: Ekko deals mainly magic damage, and Zed has low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots and build Maw of Malmortius against his magic burst. If Ekko R Chronobreak's healing keeps you from killing him in one combo, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Ekko.combo: Confirm that Ekko R Chronobreak is down, then wait for your energy and cooldowns before engaging with Zed R Death Mark. Next, place Zed W Living Shadow and use Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash so both you and your shadow hit him. If Ekko is below half health, weave in one basic attack before the mark detonates to trigger Zed P Contempt for the Weak.
Ekko.escape: If only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, he can still escape with Ekko R Chronobreak, so don't engage hastily. Wait for both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak to be down, and, if possible, wait until he also uses Ekko E Phase Dive before engaging with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark. Before going in, place Zed W Living Shadow safely behind you to secure a return point after the mark detonates.
Ekko.fight: Avoid the area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence, and fight after Ekko R Chronobreak is down. For a short trade, send Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Ekko, then use Zed Q Razor Shuriken followed by Zed E Shadow Slash. If Ekko E Phase Dive is also down, close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark.
Ekko.laning: Don't use Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions; find an angle where Zed W Living Shadow and your body hit with their abilities together to regain energy. If the enemy jungler is missing, don't waste Zed W Living Shadow on harass.
Ekko.phase: Zed peaks in mid game when he has a couple of items, so build a lead when Ekko R Chronobreak is down. Late game, Zed falls off sharply as enemies build armor and group up, so build a big lead in mid game.
Ekko.teamfight: Target one enemy damage dealer from the flank or behind instead of going in head-on. Enter with Zed R Death Mark after the enemy's protection and crowd control have been fully expended on your team and you've avoided the area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence. Secure a return point with Zed W Living Shadow so you survive until the mark detonates.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, stay out of its area to avoid the stun and shield. Ekko Q Timewinder deals more damage on the return hit, so get out of its return path. If you see Ekko's afterimage, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready; don't chase recklessly even if he looks low on health.

Fizz.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Fizz deals mainly magic damage, and Zed has low magic resistance, so build Maw of Malmortius afterward for magic resistance.
Fizz.combo: For a basic trade, send Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Fizz, then use Zed Q Razor Shuriken followed by Zed E Shadow Slash. To go for a kill, wait for your energy and cooldowns, close in with Zed R Death Mark, then place W so you and your shadow hit with Q and E together. If Fizz is below half health, weave in one basic attack to trigger Zed P Contempt for the Weak before the mark detonates.
Fizz.escape: Look to engage after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down and before it comes back. If Fizz Q Urchin Strike is still available, he can escape with it, so check whether he uses it before closing the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark. When going in with Zed R, secure a shadow position to return to after the mark detonates.
Fizz.fight: Look for a chance to counterattack right after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down. Place Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Fizz, then overlap hits from Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash. If Fizz Q Urchin Strike is still available, account for that dash before deciding whether to chase.
Fizz.laning: Look for an opening right after Fizz misses a last hit with Fizz W Seastone Trident or uses Fizz E Playful / Trickster. If the enemy jungler is missing, don't use Zed W Living Shadow to harass when you need it to escape.
Fizz.phase: Late game, Zed falls off if the enemy builds armor and groups up, so build a big lead in mid game.
Fizz.teamfight: Stay close to your allies and make Fizz use Fizz E Playful / Trickster first; once it's down, focus him with your team. Zed should target one enemy damage dealer from the flank or behind instead of going in head-on. Enter with Zed R Death Mark after the enemy's protection and crowd control have been used on your team, and secure a return point for Zed W Living Shadow so you survive until the mark detonates.
Fizz.watch: Fizz E Playful / Trickster is used both to engage and disengage, so don't dive deep with Zed R Death Mark before it's down. Fizz Q Urchin Strike is also a gap closer, so don't chase just because his E is down. If Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches its fish to you, move away from your allies before the shark detonates.

Galio.build: Galio deals mainly magic damage, and Zed has low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots, then build Maw of Malmortius.
Galio.combo: Don't start a combo while Galio W Shield of Durand is charging. Before using Zed R Death Mark, make sure your energy and cooldowns are ready; after closing in with R, place Zed W Living Shadow and use Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash so both you and your shadow hit him. If Galio is below half health, weave in one basic attack before the mark detonates.
Galio.escape: If only one of Galio E Justice Punch and Galio R Hero's Entrance is down, he can escape with the other mobility tool, so don't rush your engage. Look especially for a window before Galio R Hero's Entrance comes back, and wait outside taunt range while Galio W Shield of Durand is charging. If you placed Zed W Living Shadow safely behind you before going in, return to it right after the mark detonates.
Galio.fight: Stop trading while Galio W Shield of Durand is charging and move out of taunt range. To harass, place Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Galio, then use Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash. Hit him with abilities from both your body and shadow to regain energy.
Galio.laning: Make Galio use his abilities to clear the wave, then push the lane once he has spent mana to limit his chance to affect other lanes with Galio R Hero's Entrance. If the enemy jungler is missing, don't use Zed W Living Shadow to harass.
Galio.phase: Zed peaks in mid game when he has a couple of items, so build a lead that can end the game then. Late game, Zed falls off sharply if the enemy builds armor and groups up.
Galio.teamfight: Target one enemy damage dealer from the flank or behind instead of going in head-on. When Galio R Hero's Entrance marks its landing area, leave the area immediately, and don't start a small fight in another lane while Galio R is ready. Enter with Zed R Death Mark after the enemy's protection and crowd control have been used on your team, and secure a return point with Zed W Living Shadow so you survive until the mark detonates.
Galio.watch: When Galio charges Galio W Shield of Durand, he takes reduced damage and the taunt lasts longer, so don't commit damage during the charge; move out of range. Dodge Galio E Justice Punch when you see its tell as he steps back, and move away from where the two gusts from Galio Q Winds of War overlap.

Hwei.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Hwei deals mainly magic damage, and Zed has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance, then build Maw of Malmortius.
Hwei.combo: For a basic trade, send Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Hwei, then use Zed Q Razor Shuriken followed by Zed E Shadow Slash. To go for a solo kill, wait for your energy and cooldowns, close in with Zed R Death Mark, then place Zed W Living Shadow and use Q and E so both you and your shadow hit him. If Hwei drops below half health, trigger Zed P Contempt for the Weak with one basic attack before the mark detonates.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility, so right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is down is your chance to go in. If you placed Zed W Living Shadow safely behind you before engaging with Zed R Death Mark, return to it right after the mark detonates. While Hwei E Subject: Torment is available, its root or displacement can stop your engage.
Hwei.fight: Right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used to harass or clear minions, close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark. For trades, send Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Hwei so two hits of Zed Q Razor Shuriken overlap, then slow his escape route with the shadow's Zed E Shadow Slash.
Hwei.laning: Right after using Zed W Living Shadow, your damage and escape options are reduced, so don't waste it to harass while the enemy jungler is missing. Don't use Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions; look for an angle where your body and shadow hit the same target.
Hwei.phase: Zed peaks in mid game when he has a couple of items, so build a lead then. Late game, Zed falls off if the enemy builds armor and groups up, so avoid head-on fights.
Hwei.teamfight: Wait on the flank or behind for Hwei E Subject: Torment and the enemy's other crowd control and protection abilities to be fully expended. Then target Hwei with Zed R Death Mark, and secure a return point with Zed W Living Shadow so you survive until the mark detonates.
Hwei.watch: If you're caught by Hwei E Subject: Torment's root or displacement, you're vulnerable to follow-up damage, so delay your engage while this ability is available. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster can deal damage based on max or missing health. If the first ability hits, reposition immediately to avoid the second ability and the Hwei P Signature of the Visionary follow-up.

Irelia.combo: Before engaging, restore your energy and wait for your abilities to come off cooldown. Apply the mark first with Zed R Death Mark. Place Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Irelia, then use Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash so both you and your shadow hit her. When Irelia drops below half health, add one basic attack to trigger Zed P Contempt for the Weak, then retreat with your shadow after the mark detonates.
Irelia.escape: Right after baiting out Irelia Q Bladesurge, engage with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark if the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet is also down. Before engaging, set up a safe return point for Zed W Living Shadow, then return after the mark detonates.
Irelia.fight: Right after Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge is your chance to close the gap. If Irelia E Flawless Duet is also down, engage with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark. For a short trade, place your shadow beside or behind Irelia and hit her with Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash.
Irelia.laning: Don’t leave a minion at about half health between you and Irelia, and back off when minions are close to dying. Don’t use Zed W Living Shadow to poke when the enemy jungler is missing.
Irelia.phase: Zed falls off in the late game, so build a big lead in the mid game.
Irelia.teamfight: Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet have a big impact in teamfights, so prioritize her. Wait on a flank or behind the enemy instead of engaging head-on, then use Zed R Death Mark after the enemy has used their protection and crowd control on your team. Set up a return point with Zed W Living Shadow so you can survive until the mark detonates.
Irelia.watch: Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge to chain-dash through low-health minions toward you, so create distance when minions are close to dying. Avoid the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear.

Karma.build: Early on, withstand Karma’s magic damage with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build Maw of Malmortius later to defend against magic damage. If Karma’s healing keeps you from killing her with one full combo, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Karma.combo: Restore your energy and wait for your abilities to come off cooldown, then engage with Zed R Death Mark. Place Zed W Living Shadow so both you and your shadow hit Karma with Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash. When Karma drops below half health, add one basic attack before the mark detonates to apply Zed P Contempt for the Weak.
Karma.escape: Close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark when Karma W Focused Resolve is down and Karma E Inspire’s shield has ended. If you’re tethered by Karma W Focused Resolve, use Zed W Living Shadow to get far enough away to break the tether before you’re rooted.
Karma.fight: For trades, place Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Karma and hit her with Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash. Bait out Karma W Focused Resolve or break its tether, then engage in the window after Karma E Inspire's shield has ended.
Karma.laning: If Karma keeps hitting you with abilities, Karma P Gathering Fire reduces Karma R Mantra’s cooldown, so move behind minions or out of her range. Don’t use Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions; look for an angle where both your shadow and your body hit the same target to restore energy. When the enemy jungler is missing, don’t waste Zed W Living Shadow on poke, since you need it to escape.
Karma.phase: Zed falls off when enemies build armor and group up in the late game, so build a lead in the mid game.
Karma.teamfight: Target one enemy carry from a flank or the backline instead of engaging head-on. Use Zed R Death Mark after Karma W Focused Resolve is down and Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire’s shield has ended. If you can place Zed W Living Shadow safely behind you before engaging, return to it right after the mark detonates.
Karma.watch: Leave the area immediately after Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma Q Inner Flame explodes. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, use Zed W Living Shadow to create distance before the root takes hold. Hold your burst right after Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire grants its shield.

Kassadin.build: Kassadin deals mostly magic damage, and Zed has low magic resistance, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots, then build Maw of Malmortius to defend against magic damage.
Kassadin.combo: For a basic trade, send Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Kassadin, then use Zed Q Razor Shuriken followed by Zed E Shadow Slash. To go for a solo kill, restore your energy and wait for your abilities to come off cooldown. Apply the mark first with Zed R Death Mark, then place W and hit Kassadin with Q and E from both you and your shadow. When Kassadin drops below half health, add one basic attack to trigger Zed P Contempt for the Weak, then retreat with your shadow after the mark detonates.
Kassadin.escape: Close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark when Kassadin R Riftwalk is down or he’s out of mana. The slow from Kassadin E Force Pulse being down is also an opening to engage. Before going in, set up a shadow to return to after the mark detonates.
Kassadin.fight: Hit the same target with Zed and his shadow to restore energy, and don’t waste W on poke when the enemy jungler is missing.
Kassadin.laning: Pressure him with your jungler to build a lead in levels and CS. Don't exhaust your energy by using Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions, and avoid unnecessary ability use near Kassadin.
Kassadin.phase: In the late game, Kassadin can use R to get into the backline and then escape, while Zed falls off, so build a big lead in the mid game.
Kassadin.teamfight: Circle around to a flank or the backline and target one enemy carry instead of engaging head-on. Use Zed R Death Mark after the enemy's protection and crowd control have been fully expended on your team, and set up a shadow return point so you can survive until the mark detonates. Don't stand alone within range of Kassadin R Riftwalk.
Kassadin.watch: Kassadin E Force Pulse slows you, and its cooldown is reduced as abilities are cast nearby, so avoid using unnecessary abilities close to him. Kassadin Q Null Sphere grants a shield that absorbs magic damage, so don’t rely on your team’s magic damage poke to start a fight.

Leblanc.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. LeBlanc deals mostly magic damage, and Zed has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance and build Maw of Malmortius.
Leblanc.combo: Restore your energy and wait for your abilities to come off cooldown before engaging with Zed R Death Mark. After applying the mark with Zed R Death Mark, place Zed W Living Shadow and use Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash so both you and your shadow hit LeBlanc. When she drops below half health, add one basic attack to trigger Zed P Contempt for the Weak, then return to a safe shadow after the mark detonates.
Leblanc.escape: Right after LeBlanc uses W Distortion is your chance to close the gap. Engage with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark after the window for her to return to her original position has passed, or after she has already returned. If you’re caught by LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains, get beyond its range before the root takes hold.
Leblanc.fight: Close the gap after LeBlanc W Distortion is down. For a trade, send Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind LeBlanc, then use Zed Q Razor Shuriken followed by Zed E Shadow Slash so both you and your shadow hit her. Don’t move forward while LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice’s mark is still on you.
Leblanc.laning: Don’t waste Zed W Living Shadow on poke when the enemy jungler is missing. Don’t use Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions; find an angle where both you and your shadow hit the same target to manage your energy. Alert your team immediately if LeBlanc pushes the wave and disappears from vision.
Leblanc.phase: Zed falls off in the late game if enemies build armor and group up, so turn your mid-game lead into a chance to end the game.
Leblanc.teamfight: Target one enemy carry from a flank or the backline instead of engaging head-on. Use Zed R Death Mark after the enemy has used their protection and crowd control on your team, and set up a return point with Zed W Living Shadow so you can survive until the mark detonates.
Leblanc.watch: If LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice’s mark is still on you, her next ability will deal heavy damage, so back off until it disappears. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, use Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark to get beyond its range before the root takes hold. If LeBlanc P Mirror Image creates a clone, don’t rush your abilities; identify which one is actually attacking.

Lissandra.build: Early on, hold your ground with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Lissandra deals mostly magic damage, and Zed has low magic resistance, so build Maw of Malmortius. If Lissandra’s healing keeps you from killing her with one full combo, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Lissandra.combo: After restoring your energy and waiting for your abilities to come off cooldown, use Zed R Death Mark first to apply the mark. Then place Zed W Living Shadow and use Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash so both you and your shadow hit Lissandra. When she drops below half health, add one basic attack to trigger Zed P Contempt for the Weak. If Lissandra R Frozen Tomb grants damage immunity, time your remaining damage for when it ends.
Lissandra.escape: Right after Lissandra E Glacial Path is down is your window to engage with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark. If Lissandra W Ring of Frost is also down, it’s a good time to trade while avoiding the root. Before going in, set up a shadow to return to after the mark detonates.
Lissandra.fight: Trade right after Lissandra uses W Ring of Frost on the wave or misses it. Send Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Lissandra, land both shurikens from Zed Q Razor Shuriken on her, then use Zed E Shadow Slash. If Lissandra E Glacial Path is also down, close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark.
Lissandra.laning: Farm from an angle that keeps you out of the path of Lissandra Q Ice Shard as it pierces through allied minions. Don’t run out of energy by using Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions. Don’t waste Zed W Living Shadow on poke when the enemy jungler is missing.
Lissandra.phase: Zed peaks in the mid game when he has a couple of items, so use the lead you gain then to create a chance to end the game. Zed falls off sharply in the late game when enemies build armor and group up.
Lissandra.teamfight: Target one enemy carry from a flank or the backline instead of engaging head-on. Check whether Lissandra E Glacial Path is down, and use Zed R Death Mark after the enemy has used their protection and crowd control on your team. Set up a return point with Zed W Living Shadow so you can survive until the mark detonates.
Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard pierces after hitting its first target, so don’t stand in a straight line with allied minions. Being caught by Lissandra W Ring of Frost’s root and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb’s stun makes it easy to take magic damage in succession. When Lissandra can cast R Frozen Tomb on herself, space out your attacks until her damage immunity ends.

Lux.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Lux deals mostly magic damage, and Zed has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance and get Maw of Malmortius.
Lux.combo: Restore your energy and wait for your abilities to come off cooldown, then engage with Zed R Death Mark. Place Zed W Living Shadow and use Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash so both you and your shadow hit Lux. If Lux is below half health, add one basic attack before the mark detonates to trigger Zed P Contempt for the Weak.
Lux.escape: When Lux Q Light Binding misses, that’s your chance to engage. Lux has no mobility ability, so close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark. If you placed Zed W Living Shadow safely behind you before engaging, return to it right after the mark detonates.
Lux.fight: Bait out and dodge Lux Q Light Binding, then close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark. For a trade, place Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Lux, then use Zed Q Razor Shuriken followed by Zed E Shadow Slash. Don’t use Zed W Living Shadow to poke when the enemy jungler is missing, since you need it to escape.
Lux.laning: Lux Q Light Binding roots up to the first two enemies it hits, so don’t stand in a straight line with your ally. Don’t spend energy using Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions; find an angle where both your shadow and your body hit the same target. If Lux’s abilities hit you, create distance to avoid her empowered basic attack.
Lux.phase: Zed falls off in the late game if enemies build armor and group up, so build a lead in the mid game.
Lux.teamfight: Target Lux from a flank or the backline instead of engaging head-on. Use Zed R Death Mark after Lux Q Light Binding and the enemy’s other protection abilities have been used on your team. Approach from a different direction than your allies so you aren’t all caught by Lux E Lucent Singularity, and set up a shadow return point so you can survive until the mark detonates.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, she can easily land her follow-up abilities, so bait it out and dodge it. Leave the area where Lux E Lucent Singularity lands, and sidestep when you see the red targeting line from Lux R Final Spark. If Lux’s abilities hit you, don’t stay within basic attack range while Lux P Illumination is on you.

Mel.build: Mel deals mostly magic damage, and Zed has low magic resistance, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots, then build Maw of Malmortius to defend against magic damage.
Mel.combo: After Mel W Rebuttal is down, restore your energy and wait for your abilities to come off cooldown, then engage with Zed R Death Mark. Place Zed W Living Shadow and use Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash so both you and your shadow hit Mel, then add one basic attack when she drops below half health. Keep dealing damage until the mark detonates, then escape with your shadow.
Mel.escape: Mel has no mobility ability, so dodge Mel E Solar Snare, then engage with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark once Mel W Rebuttal is also down. If Mel E Solar Snare roots you, Mel Q Radiant Volley can follow, so leave yourself room to dodge with Zed W Living Shadow beforehand.
Mel.fight: Bait out Mel W Rebuttal with a basic attack or another action first, then sidestep Mel E Solar Snare and close the gap. For a short trade, send Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Mel so both shurikens from Zed Q Razor Shuriken hit her, then follow with Zed E Shadow Slash. Don’t use Zed W Living Shadow to poke when the enemy jungler is missing, since it’s your escape tool.
Mel.laning: Pressure Mel early by pushing the lane or closing the gap to limit her chance to scale. Don’t use Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions; find an angle where both Zed and his shadow hit the same target to restore energy. If Mel has hit you with her poke several times, don’t try to hold out based only on your remaining health.
Mel.phase: Early on, slow Mel’s growth with trades and pressure. Mel keeps the growth she builds with Mel R Golden Eclipse permanently, while Zed falls off late, so build a big lead in the mid game.
Mel.teamfight: Target Mel from a flank or the backline instead of engaging head-on. Use Zed R Death Mark after Mel W Rebuttal and Mel E Solar Snare have been used, and set up a return point with Zed W Living Shadow so you can survive until the mark detonates.
Mel.watch: If Mel E Solar Snare hits you in the center, you’ll be rooted and can easily be hit by Mel Q Radiant Volley, so sidestep and save Zed W Living Shadow. If you throw Zed Q Razor Shuriken while Mel W Rebuttal is active, it can be reflected, so bait out Mel W Rebuttal first. If repeated hits have stacked Overwhelm on you, back off even if you still have health, and watch out for Mel R Golden Eclipse’s finishing blow. Wait somewhere safe until the stacks disappear.

Orianna.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Orianna’s magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots, then build Maw of Malmortius.
Orianna.combo: Before going in with Zed R Death Mark, make sure your energy and abilities are ready. Apply the mark first with Zed R Death Mark, then place Zed W Living Shadow and land both your and the shadow’s Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash. If Orianna is below half health, weave in one basic attack before the mark detonates to add Zed P Contempt for the Weak damage.
Orianna.escape: Orianna has no ability to create distance on her own, so look for a chance to close the gap with Zed R Death Mark after Orianna R Command: Shockwave is down. If you placed Zed W Living Shadow safely behind you before engaging, return to that shadow right after the mark detonates. You can also double-tap Zed W Living Shadow to move immediately to the shadow’s position when escaping.
Orianna.fight: Right after Orianna moves her ball away from herself with Orianna Q Command: Attack, she loses the armor and magic resistance from Orianna E Command: Protect’s passive, giving you a chance to trade. Send Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Orianna and attack with Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash. Don’t use Zed W Living Shadow to poke when the enemy jungler is missing.
Orianna.laning: However, don’t let Orianna P Clockwork Windup hit you with repeated basic attacks for long. Don’t use Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions; manage your energy by hitting the same target with the shadow’s and your own attacks.
Orianna.phase: In the late game, Zed’s power falls off sharply when the enemy builds armor and groups up, so build a major advantage in the midgame.
Orianna.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front; watch the position of Orianna’s ball from the side or rear. After defensive abilities such as Orianna E Command: Protect and Orianna R Command: Shockwave have been used on your team, engage with Zed R Death Mark if you can target Orianna. Set up a return point with Zed W Living Shadow so you can survive until the mark detonates.
Orianna.watch: When Orianna moves her ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack, watch where it lands and position accordingly. Near the ball, beware of the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance and the pull from Orianna R Command: Shockwave. Also avoid fights where Orianna P Clockwork Windup lets her hit you with repeated empowered basic attacks.

Qiyana.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Qiyana P Royal Privilege, Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, and Qiyana E Audacity. You don’t need to build magic resistance specifically for the magic damage from Qiyana W Terrashape, and avoid choices that greatly increase health alone, since Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent deals damage based on maximum health.
Qiyana.combo: Once your energy and abilities are ready, use Zed R Death Mark first to apply the mark. Follow by placing Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Qiyana, then use Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash so both you and the shadow hit her. If Qiyana is below half health, weave in one basic attack before the mark detonates. Survive until it detonates, then use the shadow to escape.
Qiyana.escape: Don’t rush in when only Qiyana W Terrashape is down, since she can still escape with Qiyana E Audacity. Once both Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity are down, especially before Qiyana E Audacity comes back up, close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark. Check that you have room to avoid her root and stun before going in.
Qiyana.fight: Trade back after both Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity are down. Send Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Qiyana and trade with Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash. Zed is vulnerable right after using Zed W Living Shadow, so don’t use it to poke when the enemy jungler is missing.
Qiyana.laning: Don’t use Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions; hit the same target with Zed W Living Shadow and your own abilities to restore energy. Trade when Qiyana has used all her abilities and stays in front of you.
Qiyana.phase: Both champions are strong in the midgame, so Zed needs to build an advantage during this phase. In the late game, group up against Qiyana, but don’t give her an angle to detonate Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent on terrain.
Qiyana.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front; target one enemy damage dealer from the side or rear. Engage with Zed R Death Mark after crowd control, including Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, has been used on your team, and set up a return point with Zed W Living Shadow. Even when with your team, beware of Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent near walls, the river, and narrow passages.
Qiyana.watch: Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent knocks enemies back, then explodes and stuns them if the shockwave hits terrain, so don’t stand with your back to a wall and avoid river and narrow passages. If Qiyana has the river element, move out of range of the root from Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal; if she disappears with the brush element, move into your allies’ vision.

Ryze.build: Early on, hold out with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Ryze’s main damage is magic, and Zed has low magic resistance, so build Maw of Malmortius afterward.
Ryze.combo: Once your energy and abilities are ready, go in first with Zed R Death Mark. Follow with Zed W Living Shadow, then aim for both you and the shadow to land Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash. If Ryze falls below half health, weave in one basic attack before the mark detonates.
Ryze.escape: If you dodged Ryze E Spell Flux or Ryze W Rune Prison is down, look for a chance to close in while avoiding the root. When you engage, set up a return point with Zed W Living Shadow.
Ryze.fight: While Ryze R Realm Warp is unavailable, close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow and keep up the pressure. To trade, place the shadow beside or behind Ryze and land Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash together.
Ryze.laning: Pressure Ryze early to slow his growth before he gets his items. Don’t use Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions; manage your energy by setting up an angle where both the shadow and you hit the same target. When the enemy jungler is missing, don’t use Zed W Living Shadow for poke, since you need it to escape.
Ryze.phase: Pressure Ryze in lane early, when Zed’s trades are strong and Ryze lacks mana and damage. Look for a solo kill after learning Zed R Death Mark, then build your lead during Zed’s strong midgame, when he has a couple of items. Zed’s power falls off late, so build an advantage in the midgame large enough to end the game.
Ryze.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front; look for an angle to get onto Ryze from the side or rear. Engage with Zed R Death Mark after the enemy’s protective abilities and crowd control have been used on your team. Set up a return point with Zed W Living Shadow so you can survive until the mark detonates.
Ryze.watch: If Ryze E Spell Flux hits you, separate from your allies and keep your distance until the mark disappears. While marked, Ryze W Rune Prison becomes a root and Ryze Q Overload deals increased damage, so dodge Ryze E Spell Flux first.

Syndra.build: Early on, withstand Syndra’s magic damage with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build Maw of Malmortius afterward, and keep your total health in mind against the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.combo: For a short trade, place Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Syndra, then use Zed Q Razor Shuriken followed by Zed E Shadow Slash. When looking for a kill, make sure your energy and abilities are ready, go in with Zed R Death Mark, then place Zed W Living Shadow and overlap hits from Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash. If Syndra is below half health, weave in one basic attack so Zed P Contempt for the Weak applies.
Syndra.escape: The moment after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down is your chance to engage. If you placed Zed W Living Shadow safely behind you before going in, return to that shadow right after Zed R Death Mark detonates.
Syndra.fight: When Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark. To trade, send Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Syndra and overlap hits from Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash.
Syndra.laning: Buy boots early to walk away from the spots targeted by Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak. When the enemy jungler is missing, don’t use Zed W Living Shadow to poke, and don’t spend your energy using Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions.
Syndra.phase: Zed peaks in the midgame when he has a couple of items, so build an advantage then. In the late game, Zed loses power when the enemy builds armor and groups up, so avoid front-to-front fights.
Syndra.teamfight: Target Syndra from the side or rear after crowd control such as Syndra E Scatter the Weak has been used on your team. Move to a different entry point if several Syndra Q Dark Sphere are on the ground, since Syndra R Unleashed Power is dangerous there. Set up a return point with Zed W Living Shadow so you can survive until Zed R Death Mark detonates.
Syndra.watch: If Syndra Q Dark Sphere is between Syndra and Zed, Syndra E Scatter the Weak can push the sphere into you and stun you, so move out of its line. Syndra W Force of Will slows and deals true damage, and beware of the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power when your health is low.

Talon.build: All of Talon’s damage is physical, so build armor first with Cloth Armor early. Later, build armor and health together to prepare for Talon’s flat penetration, and don’t prioritize magic resistance. If the healing from Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy means you can’t kill him in one combo, slot Executioner's Calling between core items.
Talon.combo: Once your energy and abilities are ready, apply the mark first with Zed R Death Mark. Follow by placing Zed W Living Shadow and use Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash so both you and the shadow hit Talon. If Talon falls below half health, land one basic attack before the mark detonates to apply Zed P Contempt for the Weak, and make sure you have a shadow to return to.
Talon.escape: Right after Talon uses Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, look for a chance to close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark. You can counterattack more safely after dodging the return path of Talon W Rake and confirming Talon R Shadow Assault is down.
Talon.fight: After dodging the return path of Talon W Rake, send Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Talon and hit him with Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash. Zed is weaker right after using Zed W Living Shadow, so don’t waste it on poke when the enemy jungler is missing. Counterattack once you confirm Talon R Shadow Assault is down.
Talon.laning: Don’t spend your energy using Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions. Share position information and ward jungle routes to prepare for roams with Talon E Assassin's Path.
Talon.phase: Both champions have less influence in the late game, so Zed should avoid engaging from the front and pick his opportunities.
Talon.teamfight: Group with your allies so you can respond as soon as Talon gets into the backline. Zed should wait on the side or rear, then engage on one damage dealer with Zed R Death Mark after the enemy’s protective abilities and crowd control have been used. Survive until the mark detonates and set up a return point with Zed W Living Shadow.
Talon.watch: If Talon W Rake hits both on the way out and back, Talon’s follow-up combo with Talon P Blade's End becomes stronger. If the first hit lands, focus on moving out of its return path. Don’t chase recklessly while Talon R Shadow Assault is available, since it grants stealth and bonus movement speed.

TwistedFate.build: Build a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Twisted Fate’s main damage is magic, and Zed has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance over armor and build Maw of Malmortius.
TwistedFate.combo: For a basic trade, send Zed W Living Shadow to Twisted Fate’s side or behind him, then use Zed Q Razor Shuriken followed by Zed E Shadow Slash. Before engaging with Zed R Death Mark, make sure your energy and abilities are ready. Apply the mark first, then place Zed W Living Shadow so Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash hit with both Zed and his shadow. If Twisted Fate is below half health, also land one basic attack while the mark is active to trigger Zed P Contempt for the Weak.
TwistedFate.escape: Close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark, but secure a shadow position to escape to. After the mark detonates, return to Zed W Living Shadow placed somewhere safe.
TwistedFate.fight: When Twisted Fate has used his gold card or is holding a blue or red card, use Zed W Living Shadow to set up an angle and hit him with Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash. If the enemy jungler is not visible, don’t waste Zed W Living Shadow on poke.
TwistedFate.laning: Manage your energy by setting up angles where Zed W Living Shadow and Zed himself hit the same target with their abilities. Don’t use Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions, and respond to Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards by standing behind minions.
TwistedFate.phase: Zed peaks in the midgame when he gets a couple of items, so build an advantage then. In the late game, Zed falls off when the enemy builds armor and groups up, so avoid head-on fights.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Engage from the flank or behind after Twisted Fate has used the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and the enemy has used their protection and crowd control on your team. Target low-defense Twisted Fate with Zed R Death Mark, and secure a place to return to with Zed W Living Shadow so you can survive until the mark detonates.
TwistedFate.watch: When Twisted Fate is holding a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay outside his attack range. Take Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from behind minions to reduce poke damage.

Veigar.build: Build a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Veigar’s main damage is magic, and Zed has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance and choose Maw of Malmortius.
Veigar.combo: Before engaging with Zed R Death Mark, make sure your energy and abilities are ready. Apply the mark first, then place Zed W Living Shadow and use Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash so both Zed and his shadow hit. If Veigar is below half health, weave in one basic attack to trigger Zed P Contempt for the Weak, then escape with your shadow after the mark detonates.
Veigar.escape: Veigar has no mobility ability, so engage with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark after Veigar E Event Horizon is down. Before going in, place the shadow you’ll return to safely behind you to secure an escape route.
Veigar.fight: When Veigar E Event Horizon is down, that’s your chance to close the gap. For a trade, send Zed W Living Shadow to Veigar’s side or behind him, then use Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash so both Zed and his shadow hit. Keep moving to dodge Veigar W Dark Matter, and don’t waste Zed W Living Shadow on poke when the enemy jungler is not visible.
Veigar.laning: Veigar Q Baleful Strike pierces only the first two units it hits, so stand behind minions to avoid taking unnecessary hits. Don’t use Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions; set up an angle where both Zed and his shadow hit the same target to restore energy.
Veigar.phase: Early on, Veigar has low armor and few stacks, giving Zed a chance to pressure him. In the late game, Veigar keeps gaining stacks while Zed falls off, so check Veigar’s position and whether Veigar E Event Horizon has been used before fighting for an objective.
Veigar.teamfight: Check Veigar’s position from the flank or behind instead of engaging head-on. After the enemy uses protection and crowd control on your team, target one damage dealer with Zed R Death Mark, and secure a place to return to with Zed W Living Shadow so you can survive until the mark detonates.
Veigar.watch: Veigar E Event Horizon stuns you when you cross its edge. If trapped inside, don’t run into the edge; move around inside, and use Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark to get out. Veigar W Dark Matter shows where it will land in advance, so sidestep it. If health has decreased, get out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which deals more damage based on the target’s missing health.

Vex.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Vex’s main damage is magic, and Zed has low magic resistance, so build Maw of Malmortius afterward.
Vex.combo: Before using Zed R Death Mark, make sure your energy and abilities are ready. After engaging with R, place Zed W Living Shadow and use Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash so both Zed and his shadow hit. If Vex falls below half health, weave in one basic attack, then escape with your shadow after the mark detonates.
Vex.escape: Engage during the window after the Doom empowerment from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom has been consumed and Vex W Personal Space is down. If Vex R Shadow Surge is also down, close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark while Vex has no mobility ability to create distance. Secure the position of a shadow you can return to before engaging.
Vex.fight: Engage after the Doom empowerment from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom has been consumed on the wave or for poke, and Vex W Personal Space is down. For a trade, send Zed W Living Shadow to Vex’s side or behind her, then use Zed Q Razor Shuriken followed by Zed E Shadow Slash. Set up an angle where both the shadow’s and Zed’s abilities hit to restore energy.
Vex.laning: Don’t waste Zed W Living Shadow on poke when the enemy jungler is not visible. Don’t use Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions; look for an angle where you and your shadow can hit Vex.
Vex.phase: In the late game, Zed falls off when the enemy builds armor and groups up, so build on your mid-game advantage.
Vex.teamfight: Don’t engage head-on; wait on the flank or behind for Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear and Vex W Personal Space to be used. When targeting Vex, secure the position of the Zed W Living Shadow you can return to, and survive until Zed R Death Mark detonates. Move low-health allies out of Vex’s range first so Vex R Shadow Surge cannot trigger a chain dash with its first takedown.
Vex.watch: Hold your dash if the Doom indicator from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is visible. If you engage with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark, Vex’s basic abilities can interrupt your dash and fear you. Vex E Looming Darkness grows larger the farther it travels, so if you’re already within range, make a short sidestep.

Viktor.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Viktor’s main damage is magic, and Zed has low magic resistance, so build Maw of Malmortius.
Viktor.combo: Make sure your energy and abilities are ready, engage with Zed R Death Mark, then place Zed W Living Shadow. Follow with Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash so both Zed and his shadow hit. If Viktor is below half health, also land one basic attack to trigger Zed P Contempt for the Weak. Keep dealing damage until the mark detonates, but don’t stay inside Viktor W Gravity Field.
Viktor.escape: Viktor has no dash to escape on his own, so engage with Zed R Death Mark while Viktor W Gravity Field is down. If you placed Zed W Living Shadow safely behind you before engaging, return to it right after the mark detonates. If Viktor W Gravity Field appears where you engaged, don’t continue fighting inside it; escape with Zed W Living Shadow.
Viktor.fight: When Viktor W Gravity Field is down, close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark. For a short trade, send the shadow to Viktor’s side or behind him, overlap two hits of Zed Q Razor Shuriken, then slow him with the shadow’s Zed E Shadow Slash. Factor in the shield and movement speed from Viktor Q Siphon Power when calculating your damage.
Viktor.laning: Pressure Viktor early, before Viktor P Glorious Evolution stacks up. Check the enemy jungler’s position before using Zed W Living Shadow to poke, and hit with both Zed and his shadow to restore energy. Don’t stand in line with the wave so you can dodge Viktor E Hextech Ray, and don’t use Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions.
Viktor.phase: Early on, before Viktor P Glorious Evolution stacks up, Zed has a chance to pressure him. Viktor gets stronger over time while Zed falls off late, so recalculate the same trade once Viktor has built up his upgrades.
Viktor.teamfight: Target Viktor from the flank or behind instead of engaging head-on. After the enemy uses crowd control and protection, such as Viktor W Gravity Field, on your team, engage with Zed R Death Mark. Secure a place to return to with Zed W Living Shadow so you can survive until the mark detonates.
Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a straight line, so don’t stand in line with the minion wave; sidestep it. Viktor W Gravity Field stuns you if you stay inside its area, so leave immediately with Zed W Living Shadow when it appears and don’t continue trading inside it. Don’t stay where Viktor R Arcane Storm is placed, either.

Vladimir.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Vladimir’s main damage is magic, and Zed has low magic resistance, so build Maw of Malmortius. If you can’t kill him with one combo because of his healing, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Vladimir.combo: First send Zed W Living Shadow to Vladimir’s side or behind him, then trade with Zed Q Razor Shuriken followed by Zed E Shadow Slash to draw out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool. Once the pool ends, if your energy and abilities are ready, engage with Zed R Death Mark. Place Zed W Living Shadow and use Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash to hit with both Zed and his shadow. Against Vladimir below half health, weave in one basic attack before the mark detonates to trigger Zed P Contempt for the Weak.
