Vladimir.escape: When Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down, that’s your chance to engage. If Vladimir has also used E Tides of Blood, close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark. Before engaging, place Zed W Living Shadow safely behind you and return to it right after the mark detonates.
Vladimir.fight: Use Zed W Living Shadow to place a shadow to the side or behind Vladimir, hit him with both Zed Q Razor Shurikens, then stick to him with the slow from Zed E Shadow Slash. Once Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down, close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark.
Vladimir.laning: When poking, place Zed W Living Shadow so both Zed and his shadow hit with their abilities and restore energy. When the enemy jungler is not visible, don’t use the Zed W Living Shadow you need for escape to poke.
Vladimir.phase: In the late game, Vladimir grows stronger and becomes harder to deal with, while Zed falls off when the enemy builds armor and groups up, so build a solid mid-game advantage.
Vladimir.teamfight: Target one enemy damage dealer from the flank or behind instead of engaging head-on. Don’t group up with allies inside the area of Vladimir R Hemoplague, and if infected, engage after its effect ends. After the enemy uses protection and crowd control on your team, cast Zed R Death Mark and secure a place to return to with Zed W Living Shadow so you can survive until the mark detonates.
Vladimir.watch: Vladimir W Sanguine Pool breaks target locks and destroys projectiles, so don’t engage first with Zed R Death Mark while Vladimir still has Sanguine Pool available. If Vladimir charges E Tides of Blood, put minions between you or move out of range. If you are infected by Vladimir R Hemoplague, step back and re-engage after the effect ends.

Xerath.build: Build a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Xerath’s main damage is magic, and Zed has low magic resistance, so build Maw of Malmortius.
Xerath.combo: Start with your energy and abilities ready when Xerath’s stun and slow are down. Engage first with Zed R Death Mark, place Zed W Living Shadow, then land Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash with both Zed and his shadow. If Xerath falls below half health, land one basic attack to trigger Zed P Contempt for the Weak, and survive until the mark detonates.
Xerath.escape: The window to engage is right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down. Xerath has no mobility ability, so close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark. If you can place Zed W Living Shadow safely behind you before engaging, return to it right after the mark detonates.
Xerath.fight: When Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark. For a short trade, send Zed W Living Shadow to Xerath’s side or behind him, then hit with Zed Q Razor Shuriken followed by Zed E Shadow Slash. You are vulnerable right after using Zed W Living Shadow, so don’t waste it on poke when the enemy jungler is not visible.
Xerath.laning: Rather than trying to dodge all of Xerath’s poke, farm while avoiding the heavy damage. After Xerath has spent a lot of mana, push the lane and call your jungler. Don’t use Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions; when trading, hit with both Zed and his shadow to restore energy.
Xerath.phase: In the late game, Zed falls off when the enemy builds armor and groups up, so build an advantage in mid-game.
Xerath.teamfight: Target Xerath from the flank or behind instead of engaging head-on. After crowd control such as Xerath E Shocking Orb and the enemy’s protection have been used on your team, engage with Zed R Death Mark. Secure a place to return to with Zed W Living Shadow so you can survive until the mark detonates.
Xerath.watch: If Xerath E Shocking Orb stuns you, you can take the full follow-up, so engage after dodging it. Xerath Q Arcanopulse pierces minions, so when you see him charging, change direction and move well to the side. Watch out for the slow from Xerath W Eye of Destruction, too. When Xerath R Rite of the Arcane begins, dodge immediately or engage on Xerath while he cannot move.

Yasuo.build: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath deal primarily physical damage, so build armor first. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade deals magic damage and is not blocked by armor.
Yasuo.combo: After stripping Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield, use Zed W Living Shadow to his side or behind him for a basic trade, then cast Zed Q Razor Shuriken followed by Zed E Shadow Slash. If Yasuo W Wind Wall is active, find an angle where it won’t block your shurikens or wait for the wall to disappear. Before engaging with Zed R Death Mark, make sure your energy and abilities are ready. After R, place W, hit with Q and E using both Zed and his shadow, then weave in one basic attack against Yasuo if he is below half health.
Yasuo.escape: The opportunity to engage comes right after Yasuo throws his tornado and before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is a dash with a short cooldown, so don’t engage just because he has used it once. If you placed Zed W Living Shadow safely behind you before engaging with Zed R Death Mark, return to it right after the mark detonates.
Yasuo.fight: Strip Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with cheap poke before trading. After Yasuo throws his tornado, while he has no means to knock you up, place Zed W Living Shadow to his side or behind him and hit him with Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the wave thin on your side of the lane to reduce the minion platforms Yasuo can use to approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Don’t spend energy using Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions. When the enemy jungler is not visible, don’t waste the Zed W Living Shadow you need for trading and escape on poke.
Yasuo.phase: Zed peaks in the mid game around the time he gets a couple of items, so build an advantage then. In the late game, Zed falls off sharply when the enemy builds armor and groups up.
Yasuo.teamfight: Target one enemy damage dealer from the flank or behind instead of engaging head-on. After the enemy uses protection and crowd control on your team, engage with Zed R Death Mark. Secure a place to return to with Zed W Living Shadow so you can survive until the mark detonates.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hit area, so move sideways to dodge when Yasuo approaches. After he hits Q Steel Tempest twice, his next attack becomes a tornado that knocks you up, so dodge based on its sound and visual effect. Yasuo W Wind Wall blocks projectiles, so save Zed Q Razor Shuriken while it is active or reposition for an angle around the wall.

Yone.build: The information provided isn’t enough to determine a specific item to buy first. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so avoid building resistance to only one damage type. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your maximum health, so rather than only stacking health, consider movement speed to leave its telegraphed area and the attack speed reduction.
Yone.combo: Make sure you have enough energy and your abilities are ready, then apply the mark first with Zed R Death Mark. Next, place Zed W Living Shadow and use Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash so both Zed and his shadow hit. If Yone is below half health, weave in one basic attack during the combo to trigger Zed P Contempt for the Weak, then return to a safe shadow after the mark detonates.
Yone.escape: Don’t engage just because one of Yone’s mobility abilities is down; look for an opportunity before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back up. If the tornado stacks from Yone Q Mortal Steel have disappeared and Yone E Soul Unbound is also down, close the gap with Zed W Living Shadow and Zed R Death Mark. Before engaging, secure the position of the Zed W Living Shadow you can return to after the mark detonates.
Yone.fight: Keep your distance while Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado is ready, and look to trade after its stacks disappear. Send Zed W Living Shadow to Yone’s side or behind him to hit with Zed Q Razor Shuriken from two directions, then slow him with the shadow’s Zed E Shadow Slash. When the enemy jungler is not visible, don’t use the Zed W Living Shadow you need to escape for poke.
Yone.laning: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, watch for his tornado and wait out the stacks from outside its range. Don’t use Zed Q Razor Shuriken only to clear minions; manage your energy by setting up an angle where both Zed and his shadow hit the same target.
Yone.phase: In the late game, Zed has trouble dealing with opponents who build armor and group up, so use his mid-game strength to build an advantage that can close out the game.
Yone.teamfight: Approach from the flank or behind instead of head-on, and target one damage dealer with Zed R Death Mark after the enemy uses protection and crowd control on your team. Spread out so multiple allies don’t get hit by Yone W Spirit Cleave, and don’t stand alone in the back along the path of Yone R Fate Sealed. Secure a place to return to with Zed W Living Shadow so you can survive until the mark detonates.
Yone.watch: When Yone repeatedly hits minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel and has his tornado ready, watch for the knock-up dash and keep your distance until the stacks disappear. After Yone engages with Yone E Soul Unbound, he deals extra damage when returning to his body, so if health decreases, get out of range before he returns. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies along its path and moves him behind the last champion, so don’t stand alone in the back during team fights.

Zoe.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Zoe’s main damage is magic, and Zed has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first and complete Maw of Malmortius. You can’t reduce the true damage from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble with magic resistance, so dodging the bubble comes first.
Zoe.combo: Use Zed R Death Mark first, after your energy and ability cooldowns have recovered, to apply the mark. Then place Zed W Living Shadow beside or behind Zoe, and use Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash so both Zed and his shadow hit her. If Zoe is below half health, weave in one basic attack to apply Zed P Contempt for the Weak, and secure an exit position where you can survive until the mark detonates.
Zoe.escape: The moment Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down is your window to engage with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark.
